 For the petitioner: Mr. Ajit Sharma, Advocate.

For the Respondents: Mr. Rajan Kahol, Mr. Vishal Panwar and Mr. B.C. Verma,
 Additional Advocates General with Mr. Ravi Chauhan,
 rt Deputy Advocate General.

Since despite there being utilization of land of the petitioner by the respondents for construction of pump house and three tanks under Water Supply Scheme, he has not been paid any adequate compensation in terms of provisions contained under the Right to Fair Compensation and Yashpal Singh Sisodia vs State Of Himachal Pradesh And Others on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109847350/
1 Transparency in Land Acquisition (Resettlement and Rehabilitation) Act, 2013 (hereinafter, 'Act 2013'), petitioner is compelled to approach this court in the instant proceedings filed under Art. 226 of the Constitution of India, praying therein to issue direction to the respondents to initiate acquisition proceedings, qua the land used by them for construction of pump house/ tanks, so that adequate compensation is paid to him.

sentences.text:
2. Pursuant to notices issued in the instant proceedings, respondent No.2 Executive Engineer,
Irrigation and Public Health Nerva, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh has filed reply, wherein factum with regard to use of the land of the petitioner has not been disputed by the Department.

entities.text:
Executive Engineer,
Irrigation and Public Health Nerva
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
It has been categorically stated in the reply that the land of the petitioner would be strictly acquired as per Act 2013, after .
completion of codal formalities.

It has been further stated in the reply that the petitioner has acquired ownership of land vide mutation No. 203, dated 28.10.2021 (Annexure R-3) and before aforesaid date, suit land was in the name of Government of Himachal Pradesh earlier, as such, at that time, there was no of question of obtaining consent from the petitioner.

It has been averred in the reply that after demarcation, respondents processed the case for acquisition of land as rt per Act,
2013.

It has been stated that case for acquisition of land of the petitioner was sent to Himachal Pradesh Public Works Department, South Zone, Winter Field, Shimla and Land Acquisition Officer vide letter dated 28.7.2022 returned the case file with some observations.

Respondents after preparing documents for acquisition of land, have clarified to the Land Acquisition Officer that land of the petitioner was used for construction of water supply scheme for benefit of public at large in public interest.

3. It is quite apparent from the reply filed by the respondents that the land of the petitioner already stands utilized for construction Water Supply Scheme and further steps have been taken by the department for acquisition of land.
4. Learned Additional Advocate General representing respondent No.2 fairly states that acquisition proceedings, shall be taken to logical end expeditiously.

5. Consequently in view of fair stand adopted by learned Additional Advocate General as well reply of respondent No.2, this court disposes of the present writ petition, with a direction to respondent No.2 to ensure that acquisition proceedings qua the land of the petitioner utilized for Water Supply Scheme, are concluded expeditiously, preferably within a period of three months from today.

Liberty is .
reserved to the petitioner to get the present petition revived, in case, aforesaid direction is not complied by the respondents.
6. The petition stands disposed of in the afore terms, alongwith all pending applications.
